note: Independent re-judgment against RFC 7313 Section 4 ('For a BGP speaker that supports the BGP Graceful Restart, it MUST NOT send a BoRR for an <AFI, SAFI> to a neighbor before it sends the EoR for the <AFI, SAFI> to the neighbor.'). In TestRFC7313TxBoRRBlockedBeforeEoRWhenGRSupported (internal/component/bgp/reactor/rfc7313_gr_eor_gate_test.go), only setupPeer's helper call changed from newSendPermissionReactor(peer) to newSendPermissionReactor(t, peer) to publish the test reactor's DeliveryGraph; all capability setup, paths, and assertions are unchanged. All production BoRR senders (reactorAPIAdapter.sendRouteRefreshContext, Session.SendRawMessage via checkRawBoRRAllowedHeld, reactorAPIAdapter.SelectRefresh, and Session.sendBoundMarker) still enforce Session.checkBoRRAllowedHeld under writeMu against observedBGPWriter.sentEOR[fam]. Positive proves localGR=true refuses IPv4 BoRR with errBoRRBeforeEOR and writes zero BoRR frames before IPv4 EoR (even after IPv6 EoR, isolating per-<AFI, SAFI> gating); negative proves IPv4 BoRR reaches the wire after IPv4 EoR and before EoR when localGR=false.
